review_evidence: Frame.lean: 198 lines with structure Frame, instances for IsKD45Frame/IsK45Frame, def restrictCommitment, theorems committed_restrictCommitment, restrictCommitment_eq_self, mem_slate_iff, Sincere/Competent frame conditions, and belief transfer theorems

CommonGround.lean: 191 lines with class HasCommonGround, class HasAssertion extending it, def play for assertion histories, theorems contextSet_assert, commonGround_play, commonGround_play_perm, and filter-based common ground operations

Gameboard/Basic.lean: 262 lines with defs pushQud, addFact, recordMove, swapTurn, NonResolveCond, downdateQud, theorems nonResolveCond_pushQud_iff, downdateQud_eq_self_iff, commonGround_addFact, and HasCommonGround/HasIssue instances

summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, structures, typeclasses, inductive types, and theorems with proofs. Frame.lean defines belief-commitment frames with KD45/K45 modal logic, restrictCommitment updates, and sincerity/competence frame conditions with transfer theorems. CommonGround.lean formalizes Stalnakerian common ground as filters with HasCommonGround/HasAssertion typeclasses and assertion history theorems. Gameboard/Basic.lean defines dialogue gameboard operations (pushQud, addFact, downdateQud) with NonResolveCond and common ground/issue instances. Gameboard/Defs.lean provides the foundational structures: GrammaticalDomain, Gameboard.Domain, IllocutionaryAct, SubUtterance, LocutionaryProposition, InformationStructure, and Gameboard. None are pure import aggregators, generated data, or stubs.

review_evidence: Accessibility.lean:119 defines LinearOrder on AccessibilityLevel via rank function; lines 185-260 define three criteria types (Information, Rigidity, Attenuation) each with LinearOrder instances and computable functions informativity/rigidity/attenuation
Accessibility.lean:176-180 provides DecidablePred instances for all feature predicates via case analysis on the inductive type
QUD/Basic.lean:95-98 defines inductive WellFormed predicate on Strategy with contextual subquestion condition; lines 100-116 prove WellFormed.leaf and WellFormed.isSubquestionOf_root theorems
QUD/Basic.lean:121-144 defines IsComplete using RoseTree.Licensed and multiset infimum; lines 131-144 prove IsComplete.node, IsComplete.leaf, IsComplete.node_pair with entailment conditions
summary: Both files contain substantial formal mathematical content. Accessibility.lean defines an inductive AccessibilityLevel type with 18 constructors, a LinearOrder instance via rank, feature functions (head, modified, lexical, full, deixis, stressed, bound), and three criteria structures (Information/Finset, Rigidity/LinearOrder, Attenuation/LinearOrder) with decidable predicates. QUD/Basic.lean defines Strategy as RoseTree of Questions, inductive WellFormed predicate with proofs (WellFormed.leaf, WellFormed.isSubquestionOf_root), and IsComplete predicate using multiset infimum with proofs (IsComplete.node, IsComplete.leaf, IsComplete.node_pair). Neither is a pure import aggregator, stub, or generated data.
